title: CASSINI. Report on the Phase A study: Saturn Orbiter and Titan probe
rights_note: NTRS record permits public use and reports no third-party material. Keep NASA/NTRS attribution and verify page-level notices before redistribution.

dev_context_evidence.selected_hybrid: 15/15 answerable cases with top_k=8 and 6000 characters

test_retrieval_context_evidence: 24/24 answerable cases for selected TF-IDF configuration; retrieval-only, not agent answer quality

visual_processing.method: Preserve the embedded page scan as JPEG, prioritize exact Figure/Table caption chunks when a query names an ID, and attach up to three retrieved page scans to the vision-capable agent request.
visual_processing.limitation: No standalone image embedding or OCR/layout extraction is used. The agent can inspect a visual page only when text/caption retrieval first finds that page.

processing_status: Text chunks and page images extracted for the full 148-page PDF. Pages 4 and 148 are blank scans with no extractable text; the other 146 pages yielded 463 indexed chunks. Selected dev configuration achieved 15/15 context-evidence coverage, and the locked test retrieval achieved 24/24 for answerable cases. The agent supports OpenAI or a local Ollama endpoint; agent runs, human grading, and the 90% bonus threshold remain incomplete until a provider is configured and all 30 cases are audited.
local_artifacts_note: The original PDF, page images, chunks, Qdrant index, and traces remain local under Downloads/starter/results and are not committed.
